atlasPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production videogame asset ATLAS. Square 1024x1024 strictly divided into a uniform 4 by 4 grid of 256x256 cells. No grid lines, no labels, no text. Cell objects must never overlap or leave their own cell, generous transparent margins around sprites. Row2: pink striped road barrier front view; menacing hovering drone front view; bright gold coin; cyan lightning boost pickup. Row3: neon purple skyscraper; neon cyan skyscraper; orange traffic cone; cyan speed burst.
